title: A Streaming Collectives Interface Targeting Dataflow Acceleration and HPC Workloads
problem: Dataflow accelerators lack scalable collective communication support; no framework for accelerator-initiated MPI
motivation: Dataflow accelerators offer energy efficiency but limited by communication capabilities; HLS interface needed for HPC adoption
method: HLS-based streaming interface for fine-grained host-accelerator data transfer via MPI; enhanced HPL benchmark from HPCC_FPGA
key_novelty: Streaming collective communication interface for dataflow accelerators; resource-efficient via stream-based transfers
contributions: Superlinear speedup in strong scaling stencil benchmark
limitations: Evaluation limited to 16 FPGAs; specific to HPL and stencil workloads
